evidence_articles.title: Congress promises ₹72,000 per annum to poorest people
evidence_articles.rephrased: The article covers Rahul Gandhi's announcement of the NYAY minimum income guarantee scheme, which promises to directly transfer ₹72,000 per year to the bank accounts of India's poorest 20% families.
evidence_articles.content: Congress president Rahul Gandhi on Monday announced a minimum income guarantee scheme, Nyuntam Aay Yojana (NYAY), under which ₹72,000 a year will be transferred to the bank accounts of 20% of the poorest families in the country if his party is voted to power.

recent_articles.title: DSS to hold rallies on June 16 seeking Karnataka Cabinet berth for H.C. Mahadevappa - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dalit Sangharsha Samiti**, a Karnataka-based organization, announced a statewide rally on June 16th to demand a Cabinet berth for **H.C. Mahadevappa**, a senior Congress leader and former Minister. The group highlighted **Mahadevappa's** contributions to Dalit welfare and social justice during his tenure as Minister, citing specific initiatives like securing funds for the Dr B.R. Ambedkar Bhavan and strengthening enforcement of laws against atrocities against Scheduled Castes. They urged the state Congress leadership to accommodate **Mahadevappa** in the next Cabinet expansion and provide adequate representation for Dalits in other positions of power.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal CID reaches Mamata Banerjee’s residence in signature forgery case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Criminal Investigation Department (CID)** of **West Bengal Police** searched the residence of former Chief Minister **Mamata Banerjee** at 30B, Harish Chatterjee Street in connection with allegations of forged signatures from party MLAs.  **Subhasish Chakraborty**, a former Trinamool Congress MP, prevented the search and requested a return visit when either **Mamata Banerjee** or **Abhishek Banerjee** would be present. The CID has registered an FIR based on complaints by MLAs Ritabarta Banerjee and Sandipan Saha alleging forged signatures that led to their expulsion from the party.

recent_articles.title: Jagan to visit Visakhapatnam on June 10 to console steel plant blast families - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Y. S. Jagan Mohan Reddy**, former Chief Minister of **Andhra Pradesh**, will visit Visakhapatnam on Wednesday to console families of workers killed and injured in a recent accident at the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant. He expressed condolences, demanded an investigation into the cause of the incident, and directed party leaders to provide support to the affected families and ensure proper medical care for the injured.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool, Abhishek Banerjee offices searched in signature forgery case | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The West Bengal CID** conducted searches at the **Trinamool Congress**'s central office in Kolkata and **Abhishek Banerjee's** office on Camac Street as part of its investigation into alleged Assembly signature forgery.  The searches followed a complaint filed by rebel TMC MLAs Ritabrata Banerjee and Sandipan Saha alleging fabricated signatures on a letter sent to the Assembly Speaker regarding the appointment of the Leader of Opposition. The CID has recorded statements from 13 TMC MLAs, with three disowning the signatures attributed to them. **Abhishek Banerjee** skipped a third summons issued by the Crime Investigation Department citing pending proceedings before the Calcutta High Court and his absence from the city.

recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha polls: Amid fears of cross-voting, Madhya Pradesh Congress MLAs leave for Bengaluru - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** MLAs in Madhya Pradesh are traveling to Bengaluru by chartered flight to avoid potential cross-voting in the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections.  The **Air Traffic Control (ATC)** has delayed the takeoff, causing frustration among the lawmakers.  **Umang Singhar**, Leader of Opposition in the state Assembly, stated that several BJP offers have been made to Congress MLAs, but they are united and confident in their support.

recent_articles.title: Congress MLAs Stranded At Bhopal Airport Over Plane Mix-up
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** MLAs and their families faced confusion at Bhopal Airport due to a smaller aircraft than expected for their travel to Bengaluru. The **Congress** had arranged two batches of flights, with the first flight accommodating 76 MLAs and family members, while another was planned later in the evening for the remaining MLAs.  The move came amid heightened political tension after the BJP fielded Mahesh Kevat as a candidate for the Rajya Sabha seat against Congress's Meenakshi Natarajan. The **Congress** is concerned about potential cross-voting and has decided to send its MLAs to Karnataka.

recent_articles.title: BJP Leader Girish Mahajan Criticises Operation Bluestar In Big Shift In Punjab Strategy
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** has shifted its Punjab strategy by publicly criticizing **Operation Bluestar** for the first time. Maharashtra minister Girish Mahajan, who visited the Damdami Taksal during the 42nd anniversary of the operation, described it as an attack on the Golden Temple and blamed former prime minister Indira Gandhi. This move signals an attempt to engage with Sikh sentiments that view the operation as a deep wound. However, the strategy has been met with criticism from **Punjab Congress president Amarinder Singh Raja Warring**, who accused the BJP of hypocrisy. Whether this outreach will be seen as reconciliation or electoral opportunism remains to be seen.

recent_articles.title: Chief Minister travels by Metro to avoid Zero-Traffic arrangements in Bengaluru - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar** traveled by **Namma Metro** from Vidhana Soudha to Silk Institute on Sunday, June 7, 2026, to visit his home turf of Kanakapura.  He chose this method to avoid disrupting traffic for the public after recognizing the inconvenience of using zero-traffic arrangements. The decision followed a similar incident last week where **Governor Thaawarchand Gehlot**'s convoy was granted zero-traffic access at Wind Tunnel Junction, sparking public outrage and criticism about Bengaluru's infrastructure.

recent_articles.title: Haunted by 2020, Congress flies Madhya Pradesh MLAs to Karnataka before Rajya Sabha vote | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: To secure a third seat in the June 18 Rajya Sabha election, the **BJP** needs additional votes.  The Congress has relocated nearly all of its 61 MLAs to Karnataka, citing concerns about potential BJP attempts to contact them. The move is seen as a precautionary measure to prevent defections and maintain party unity ahead of the vote.  Congress leaders have denied any discontent among their legislators and insist they are united in supporting their nominee, Meenakshi Natarajan.

recent_articles.title: Congress on reduction in number of subsidised Ujjwala refills - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** criticized the government's reduction of subsidized LPG refills under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, accusing it of "crocodile tears" and prioritizing power over poverty alleviation.  **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge highlighted the program's dwindling benefits, from 12 subsidized refills to just 4, while criticizing the government for increasing LPG prices despite claiming affordability. The **Government**, however, defended its actions, stating that Indian households still pay among the lowest global cooking gas prices despite international price hikes.

recent_articles.title: 28,000 vehicles an hour and growing; Cyberabad bets on flyovers and underpasses to ease Allwyn-Miyapur traffic snarls - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Cyberabad Municipal Corporation (CMC)** has proposed a ₹530-crore grade separator project to address traffic congestion at the Allwyn and Miyapur junctions in Hyderabad. The project, which includes flyovers, vehicle underpasses, and a bi-directional bridge spanning both junctions, aims to reduce traffic delays and improve commute times for thousands of commuters daily. **Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** laid the foundation stone for the project on June 8, 2026. The project is expected to deliver economic and environmental benefits by reducing fuel consumption, vehicle operating costs, and carbon emissions while enhancing road safety and public transportation integration.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Crisis: "BJP Won't Take Them, Not Enough Numbers": Team Mamata Banerjee On Rebels
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Mamata Banerjee** camp condemned rebels who sought support from the BJP-led NDA, calling their actions a betrayal.  Senior MP Kalyan Banerjee stated that the rebels lack sufficient numbers to merge with another party and that they will not be accepted by the BJP. The rebels chose their own chief whip, Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar, defying **Mamata Banerjee's** decision for the post. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Lok Sabha MP, is attempting to convince them to return but they remain adamant.  The rebellion poses a threat to the party leadership and its image among voters.

recent_articles.title: ‘No ID, no entry’: Karnataka orders stricter enforcement against underage drinking | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyank Kharge**, **Karnataka Home Minister**, ordered a crackdown on pubs, bars, and breweries in Bengaluru to prevent underage drinking.  He directed police to ensure no person below the legal drinking age is allowed entry or served alcohol, citing a recent study that found one-third of adolescents in the city are at risk of health issues due to alcohol or tobacco use. The study also revealed that 33% of young adults in Bengaluru used alcohol and nearly 18% were addicted to tobacco, significantly higher than national averages.  **Kharge** emphasized that establishments violating these rules will face severe consequences.

recent_articles.title: K Kavitha Slams Revanth Reddy, Demands Action On Land Owned By Pawan Kalyan
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K Kavitha**, **Telangana Rakshana Sena (TRS)** chief, accused the Revanth Reddy-led Congress government of selectively targeting poor and middle class individuals through HYDRAA anti-encroachment drives while ignoring large-scale land grabs by influential people. She alleged that nearly Rs 1 lakh crore worth of public land had been illegally occupied, including a 10-acre plot owned by **Pawan Kalyan**, the Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister and Janasena Party chief, which she claims falls within protected "Shikam" and FTL limits. Kavitha demanded immediate action against encroachers and accused the government of turning a blind eye to major real estate projects.

recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha polls: Only 4 BJP candidates in fray, party eyes clean sweep | Ahmedabad News - The Indian Express

The election for these seats is being held due to the end of the six-year term of four Rajya Sabha MPs, including Congress leader **Shaktisinh Gohil**.

recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha polls: M.P. Congress mulls moving MLAs away as BJP fields candidate on third seat - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**'s Mahesh Kewat entered the race for one of three Rajya Sabha seats in **Madhya Pradesh**, following the announcement of his candidacy on Sunday. The Congress candidate, **Meenakshi Natarajan**, is backed by all her party members and sees this as a battle between "Gandhian ideology" and the BJP's "divisive politics."

recent_articles.title: TMC unravels: Inside party MPs’ revolt against Mamata Banerjee | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress (TMC) is experiencing a significant internal crisis with at least 14 MPs attending a meeting at Union Minister Bhupender Yadav's home, claiming to form a separate bloc aligned with the BJP-led NDA.  **Mamata Banerjee**, the party chief, claims the rebels do not have the support of two-thirds of the MPs. The dissidents, led by **Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar**, claim they have 20 MPs on their side and will formally support the NDA for West Bengal's development.  The rebellion has further weakened the TMC following its defeat in the recent West Bengal Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: Idli Must Stay on Plate, Says Shashi Tharoor in Viral Food Opinion
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shashi Tharoor**, a senior Congress leader, recently commented on the pairing of idlis and chai for breakfast. **Dr Sujit Nair**, a consultant in medical gastroenterology, explained that while texture can affect digestion, factors like portion size and individual digestive health play a larger role. He noted that both idlis and tea are generally safe for most healthy adults, but sweetened tea may increase calorie intake.  He recommends pairing idlis with protein-rich accompaniments and limiting added sugar in tea to support steadier energy levels and better fullness.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Leaders** attending the **INDIA** bloc meeting at the Constitution Club of India faced difficulties with weak mobile network, leading to some being surrounded by journalists.  **TMC MPs Kalyan Banerjee** and **Dola Sen** were particularly affected as they sought to make or receive calls amidst media attention regarding the ongoing crisis in their party. recent_articles.title: Donnald Trump Nominates Former Personal Lawyer Todd Blanche As Attorney General
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** nominated his former personal lawyer, **Todd Blanche**, as US attorney general. Democrats also denounced the fund. The White House has formally sent Blanche's nomination to the Senate.

recent_articles.title: Congress workers seek Cabinet berth for Belur Gopala Krishna - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B.R. Jayanth**, a senior Congress leader, urged the party's high command to appoint **Belur Gopala Krishna**, a Congress MLA for Sagar and Belur, to the Karnataka State Cabinet.  Jayanth argued that Gopala Krishna, who has been elected three times, deserves an opportunity similar to **Madhu Bangarappa**, who served as Minister for Education for three years.

recent_articles.title: Shivamogga Muslim Rights Forum seeks DCM post for Zameer Ahmed Khan - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Poll battle among rich - The Hindu

Mohan**, a candidate from the Congress, declared assets worth ₹75.50 lakh.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool rebellion revives government hopes of passing Delimitation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** internal dissent, particularly within its parliamentary party, has reignited speculation about the government's potential introduction of the Delimitation Bill during the Monsoon Session in mid-July. The bill, aimed at redrawing electoral boundaries based on the 2011 census, failed to secure a two-thirds majority in Parliament in April and was accompanied by the Women’s Reservation Amendment Bill, which also fell short.

recent_articles.title: INDIA bloc to take SIR complaints to CJI; seeks Pradhan’s immediate exit - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The INDIA bloc, led by **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge, met to discuss concerns over the special intensive revision (SIR) and alleged 'vote loot'. The meeting saw criticism of the Congress's handling of the recent Rajya Sabha election in Bihar, with leaders calling for a more concrete organizational structure.  The bloc also discussed the post-poll violence in West Bengal and called for an all-party meeting to address the current economic situation. **Mamata Banerjee**, who led the charge for unity after her party's defeat in the recent Assembly elections, urged the alliance to respond to youth protests under the banner of the Cockroach Janta Party.  The bloc will meet again in August.

recent_articles.title: Chhagan Bhujbal sidelined, NCP’s Rajendra Jain files nomination for Rajya Sabha - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: H-1B $100,000 fee struck down as illegal: What happens next? - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A federal judge ruled that the $100,000 fee imposed by **President Donald Trump** on new H-1B visas for highly skilled foreign workers is unlawful.  The ruling invalidates the fee and was issued in a lawsuit filed by 20 **Democratic state attorneys general**. The **US Department of Homeland Security (DHS)** has not yet reacted to the decision, but the administration can appeal. Immigration attorney Rahul Reddy stated that the court determined the $100,000 charge is a tax, not a penalty, and therefore must be addressed by Congress rather than through presidential proclamation.

recent_articles.title: Omar Abdullah Invites INDIA Bloc To Join J&K Statehood Protest
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Omar Abdullah**, the **Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir**, invited members of the **INDIA bloc** to join his planned protest for the restoration of J&K's statehood at the start of the Monsoon session of parliament next month.  Abdullah, who attended today's INDIA bloc meeting, will write to opposition parties to participate in the march. This move comes after Abdullah distanced himself from the **Congress** and the **INDIA bloc** for the past 19 months, but now seeks support for his agenda.

recent_articles.title: Elections to one seat out of seven in Legislative Council being keenly watched - The Hindu

The outcome of this election is uncertain due to the preferential voting system, potential cross-voting, and the influence of expelled BJP members.

recent_articles.title: Unity in diversity: On the INDIA bloc meeting - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Twenty-three Opposition parties**, including the **Congress**, **Samajwadi Party**, and **Trinamool Congress**, met in New Delhi on Monday to address concerns about economic distress, inflation, and educational chaos.  The bloc resolved to write to the Chief Justice of India over electoral fraud allegations, demand the resignation of the Union Education Minister, call for an all-party meeting to discuss the economic crisis, agree to hold coordination meetings every two months, and commit to daily parliamentary coordination during sessions. The meeting followed recent fissures within the alliance, including the absence of the **DMK** and the **Aam Aadmi Party**, highlighting the fragility of the coalition.  Despite these challenges, there is a broad consensus on the need to checkmate the **BJP** for political survival and the health of Indian democracy.

recent_articles.title: SpaceX IPO is said to be well oversubscribed, orders close Wednesday - The Economic Times

The decision is crucial for the stability of the minority TVK government, which relies on the five Congress MLAs for support. The announcement comes after senior Congress leader and Tamil Nadu in-charge Girish Chodankar met Vijay, fueling speculation that **Congress strategist Praveen Chakravarty** could be nominated. While the move has been welcomed by the Congress, the DMK has criticized it as an attempt to avoid a direct confrontation with the BJP.

recent_articles.title: Kerala faces burden of ₹5.07-lakh crore liabilities; fiscal structure under ‘serious’ strain, says White Paper tabled by CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan** tabled a white paper in the State Assembly on Thursday, June 4, 2026, highlighting Kerala's fiscal strain. The document states that the state faces a large burden of outstanding liabilities and high interest payments, while its capital expenditure is among the lowest in India despite a high fiscal deficit.  The white paper also points to "parallel governance structures" like the **Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB)** as contributing to the fiscal stress.

recent_articles.title: B K Hariprasad is new Karnataka Congress chief | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The AICC** appointed **B K Hariprasad**, a senior Congress leader and four-time Rajya Sabha MP, as the new president of the Karnataka state unit.  Hariprasad, an OBC leader from the Billava community, is known for his association with the Gandhi family and his criticism of the RSS. His appointment is seen as a counter to **D K Shivakumar**, who has adopted a "soft Hindutva" approach.

recent_articles.title: NHRC takes cognisance of Express report on 53 maternal deaths in MP’s Sidhi, issues notice | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)** has taken notice of a report by The Indian Express detailing 53 maternal deaths in Madhya Pradesh's Sidhi district between April 2025 and March 2026.  **The NHRC** issued a notice to the state Chief Secretary, demanding a detailed report within two weeks. **Congress** leader Umang Singhar called for a review of maternal health services across the state, while BJP spokesperson Hitesh Bajpai acknowledged progress but highlighted challenges in remote areas.

recent_articles.title: Who Is Firhad Hakim, Close Mamata Banerjee Aide Who Quit As Kolkata Mayor
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee** faced a major split within her **Trinamool Congress**, with 59 of 80 MLAs supporting rebel leader Ritabrata Banerjee.  The party also saw the resignation of Firhad Hakim as Kolkata Mayor after around 100 councillors deserted the party.  Hakim had previously offered his resignation but was initially refused by **Mamata Banerjee**. Senior Trinamool leader Kunal Ghosh confirmed that Hakim's decision to resign was made with dignity and that **Mamata Banerjee** eventually agreed to it. The split comes after an administrative meeting at the state secretariat Nabanna, where several Trinamool MLAs attended, including Hakim.

recent_articles.title: Iran War: Donald Trump Faces Setback As US House Passes War Powers Resolution To End Iran War
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The US House of Representatives passed a resolution urging the withdrawal of American troops from the Iran war, a largely symbolic move that delivered a political blow to President Donald Trump. The measure, which passed 215-208, heads to the Senate but would face a presidential veto.  **Democrats** view this as a potential turning point in their efforts to reassert Congress's role in decisions of war and peace. While Republicans who support **Trump** argue that the resolution weakens the US, they are facing growing political pressure ahead of November's midterm elections.

recent_articles.title: Amid broken ties, Rahul, Kharge hail Karunanidhi on his birth anniversary - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** paid tributes to former Tamil Nadu Chief Minister **Muthuvel Karunanidhi**, fondly known as "Kalaignar," on his birthday.  Kharge praised **Karunanidhi's** lifelong commitment to social justice and democratic values, while Gandhi highlighted his dedication to the dignity of the Tamil people. The tributes are seen as an attempt to mend strained ties between the Congress and the DMK following the party's alliance with actor-turned politician Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK).

recent_articles.title: Calcutta High Court to hear Abhishek’s plea seeking protection - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, general secretary of the **Trinamool Congress**, was granted permission by the Calcutta High Court to file a petition seeking protection against coercive action from the West Bengal CID. The court is expected to hear the matter later this week.  The legal team representing Mr. Banerjee argued that he had no connection to the case, while Enforcement Directorate officials served him with a notice for questioning in the primary teacher recruitment scam. Two Trinamool MLAs filed a complaint alleging forged signatures on a letter declaring **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay** as the party's choice for Leader of Opposition (LoP), leading to an FIR and summons against Mr. Banerjee. The controversy has caused a split within the party, with at least 58 MLAs forming a new opposition group.

recent_articles.title: Congress Rahul Gandhi Priyanka Gandhi: With Eye On Upcoming Polls, Congress Plans Major Organisational Reshuffle
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the appointment of DK Shivakumar as Chief Minister of Karnataka, **BK Hariprasad** has been named the state Congress president.  The Congress is planning a major reshuffle across over six states, with a focus on poll-bound regions like Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa, Manipur, Gujarat, and Himachal Pradesh. The party is considering replacing in-charges and state presidents to attract voters and balance caste dynamics. This reshuffle is expected to be the last major one under **Mallikarjun Kharge**'s leadership as Congress president.

recent_articles.title: ‘Unauthorised’ school in Chunabhatti ordered shut, students told to relocate | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parents** of students at **Orchids International School** in Mumbai's Chunabhatti were surprised to be asked to relocate their children to other branches after the school was declared unauthorized for operating without government permission. The **school** management has been informed about the unauthorized status since March 2026, and a fine of Rs 1,00,000 has been levied. Parents argue that they were misled by the school's assurances that the situation would be resolved before classes began.  The **school** claims to have issued new information to parents about the expected final approval for operations at the Chunabhatti location by July.
